mainTopic: שמואל's view that יש זיקה, and the משנה of a brother born after יבום, where רבי שמעון's leniency is traced to זיקה and challenged by רב יוסף
overview: The גמרא first shows that שמואל holds יש זיקה, because he rules like רבי יהודה בן בתירה: a brother may not marry the sister of a שומרת יבם until the יבם does יבום or חליצה. After a short back-and-forth about why the ruling can't be רב's, רב זביד of נהרדעא reports a version where שמואל says it openly: even after a שומרת יבם dies, her mother is forbidden. The גמרא explains why both of שמואל's rulings are needed. One teaches that the bond is real even with two יבמים. The other teaches that it does not end by itself at death. A new משנה follows: if a brother is born after the second brother already did יבום, the חכמים exempt both wives, while רבי שמעון allows normal יבום. רב אושעיא proves from an otherwise extra משנה that רבי שמעון argues even when the brother was born before the יבום. The גמרא then explains that רבי שמעון's reason is that זיקה makes her like a married woman. רב יוסף objects that רבי שמעון is unsure even about זיקה plus מאמר, and the גמרא brings the משנה of three brothers to show that doubt. The discussion continues on the next amud.

steps.title: שמואל follows רבי יהודה בן בתירה, so he holds the bond is real
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא quotes רבי יהודה בן בתירה: if one brother betroths the sister of a שומרת יבם, he must wait until the יבם acts. שמואל rules that the הלכה follows him.
steps.simpleTranslation: A woman is waiting for her יבם, and his brother betroths her sister. In the name of רבי יהודה בן בתירה they said: we tell him to wait until your brother acts. And שמואל said: the הלכה follows רבי יהודה בן בתירה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ruling of שמואל to prove that he holds יש זיקה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Until the יבם does יבום or חליצה, the widow is still tied to all the brothers. So her sister counts as the sister of a woman bonded to the brother who betrothed her, and he may not marry her yet. Since שמואל rules this way, he must hold יש זיקה.

keyTerms.meaning: A widow waiting for her brother-in-law to do יבום or חליצה
An action, meaning יבום or חליצה
The final ruling follows (the opinion of)

steps.whyThisMatters: This ruling is the base for showing שמואל's view on זיקה, which the rest of the passage depends on.

phrases.aramaic: שׁוֹמֶרֶת יָבָם שֶׁקִּדֵּשׁ אָחִיו אֶת אֲחוֹתָהּ,
phrases.english: A woman waiting for her yavam, whose brother betrothed her sister,
phrases.notes: "His brother" means another brother of the יבם, not the יבם himself.

phrases.aramaic: מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָה אָמְרוּ:
phrases.english: in the name of Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira they said:
We say to him: Wait
until your brother does an action.
And Shmuel said:
The halacha follows Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָה
steps.raayaObject: That שמואל holds יש זיקה, so the earlier ruling can belong to him
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא of רבי יהודה בן בתירה together with שמואל's ruling that the הלכה follows it

steps.title: Why not say the ruling is רב's?
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף asks: what would be wrong with saying the ruling comes from רב?
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: and if it were רב's, what would be wrong?
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף asks why we need to credit the ruling to שמואל at all. This question sets up אביי's answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Showing that שמואל holds יש זיקה only proves the ruling could be his. רב יוסף wants to know what rules out רב as its author.

phrases.english: He said to him:
phrases.notes: This is רב יוסף speaking to אביי.

phrases.english: And if it were Rav's, what [would be wrong]?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions why the proof from שמואל is needed
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What problem comes up if the ruling is credited to רב

steps.title: רב would contradict himself
steps.stepSummary: אביי answers that crediting it to רב would make רב contradict his own earlier statement.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: there would be a contradiction between one statement of רב and another statement of רב.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי explains the problem: רב's other statement shows he holds אין זיקה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier, רב הונא quoted רב in a way that showed רב holds the bond is not strong. If this ruling, which assumes יש זיקה, were also רב's, רב would hold two opposite views.

keyTerms.meaning: רב against רב: one statement of רב against another

phrases.english: (He said to him:)
phrases.notes: Some versions have these words in round brackets and some don't. Either way, אביי is the one answering.

phrases.english: Rav would contradict Rav!

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Crediting the ruling to רב would set it against רב's other statement, which shows אין זיקה

steps.title: Maybe two students argue about רב's view
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף pushes back: maybe the two reports are two אמוראים who disagree about what רב held.
steps.simpleTranslation: Maybe they are אמוראים, arguing about רב's opinion.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף challenges אביי: a clash between two reports of רב doesn't have to be a real contradiction.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב הונא and רב יהודה each quoted רב. Maybe they simply disagree about what רב held. If so, the ruling could still be רב's after all.

keyTerms.meaning: According to, or about the view of

phrases.english: Perhaps they are amoraim [who disagree],
about Rav's opinion.

steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's claim that crediting the ruling to רב creates a contradiction
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Conflicting reports of one teacher's view can be explained as a dispute between his students

steps.title: An explicit שמואל source beats a forced reading
steps.stepSummary: Since the ruling clearly matches שמואל, we don't drop that in favor of inventing a dispute about רב.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since it was said clearly in שמואל's name, but in רב's name only as a dispute of אמוראים, we don't leave the clear statement in שמואל's name and explain it as a dispute of אמוראים about רב's view.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge and keeps the ruling with שמואל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Putting the ruling with רב only works if we invent a dispute between his students. Putting it with שמואל fits plainly with his known view. The plain reading wins.

phrases.english: Since it was said clearly in Shmuel's name,
while in Rav's name it would only work as a dispute of amoraim,
we do not leave the clear statement in Shmuel's name
and explain it as a dispute of amoraim about Rav's opinion.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Preference for the plain attribution over a forced explanation
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ruling could be רב's, with a dispute between his students explaining the clash
steps.terutzMaskana: The ruling is credited to שמואל, who openly holds יש זיקה

steps.title: רב זביד's version credits שמואל openly
steps.stepSummary: רב כהנא reports that רב זביד of נהרדעא learned it openly in שמואל's name: if a שומרת יבם dies, the יבם may not marry her mother. So שמואל holds יש זיקה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב כהנא said: I said this teaching before רב זביד of נהרדעא. He said: you learn it this way, by working it out. We learn it openly: רב יהודה said in the name of שמואל, if a שומרת יבם died, he may not marry her mother. So שמואל holds יש זיקה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב כהנא brings a different version that doesn't need any proof: the ruling is stated directly in שמואל's name.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Instead of working out who said it, רב זביד's tradition names שמואל outright. The ruling itself shows that the bond makes the widow's mother forbidden as if the widow were his wife, even after she died.

keyTerms.meaning: The bond between יבם and יבמה is strong, almost like marriage

steps.confusionAlert: Here "he may not marry her mother" applies even though the שומרת יבם has died. The bond does not simply disappear when she dies.

phrases.english: Rav Kahana said:

phrases.aramaic: אַמְרִיתַהּ לִשְׁמַעְתָּא קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב זְבִיד מִנְּהַרְדְּעָא,
phrases.english: I said this teaching before Rav Zevid of Neharde'a,
He said: You learn it this way!
phrases.notes: He means you only work out that it's שמואל's by proving it, as in the earlier steps.

phrases.english: We learn it openly.
Rav Yehuda said that Shmuel said:
A woman waiting for her yavam who died: he is forbidden to her mother.
So he holds the bond is real.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב כָּהֲנָא אַמְרִיתַהּ לִשְׁמַעְתָּא קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב זְבִיד מִנְּהַרְדְּעָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives another version that credits the ruling to שמואל directly, with no need for proof
steps.mimraCoreRuling: שמואל: after a שומרת יבם dies, the יבם is still forbidden to marry her mother, because יש זיקה

steps.title: This fits שמואל's other ruling
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא notes that this matches שמואל's ruling like רבי יהודה בן בתירה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And שמואל follows his own reasoning, since שמואל said: the הלכה follows רבי יהודה בן בתירה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows that the new ruling fits with what we already know about שמואל. This sets up the question of why both rulings are needed.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both rulings rest on the same idea: the bond is strong enough to forbid the widow's relatives. Since they share one idea, it looks like one of them is extra.

keyTerms.meaning: And he goes according to his own reasoning (is consistent)

phrases.english: And Shmuel follows his own reasoning,
as Shmuel said:
The halacha follows Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira.

steps.raayaObject: שמואל's view of יש זיקה is consistent
steps.raayaSupportSource: שמואל's ruling like רבי יהודה בן בתירה

steps.title: Why the ruling like רבי יהודה בן בתירה is needed
steps.stepSummary: Both rulings are needed. From the ruling about the mother alone, we might think the bond is real only when there is one יבם, not two.
steps.simpleTranslation: Both are needed. If he had only taught us יש זיקה, I would have said that applies only with one יבם but not with two. So he teaches us otherwise.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the unspoken question of why שמואל said two rulings that seem to say the same thing.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With only one יבם, the widow is clearly tied to him. When there are two possible יבמים, the bond is spread out and might seem weaker. The ruling like רבי יהודה בן בתירה, which involves another brother, teaches that the bond is real even with two.

keyTerms.meaning: I would have said (a mistaken first thought)

phrases.english: And both are needed,
for if he had only taught us that the bond is real,
phrases.notes: This is the ruling about the mother after death, from step 6.

phrases.english: I would have said: that applies with one [yavam],
but with two — not,
so he teaches us [otherwise].

steps.terutzResolutionType: צריכותא: showing that each statement teaches something new
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The bond is real only when there is one יבם
steps.terutzMaskana: The bond is real even with two יבמים

steps.title: Why the ruling about the mother is needed
steps.stepSummary: From the ruling like רבי יהודה בן בתירה alone, we might think the bond ends when the widow dies. The ruling about the mother teaches that it doesn't end by itself.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if he had only taught us that the הלכה follows רבי יהודה בן בתירה, I would have said that applies only while she is alive, but after her death the bond ends. So he teaches us that the bond does not end by itself.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes explaining why both rulings are needed, and so wraps up the passage.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה בן בתירה's case is about a living widow. Without the second ruling, we might think death ends the bond. The ruling about the mother teaches that the bond needs a real act, יבום or חליצה, to end it.

keyTerms.meaning: For nothing, by itself, without cause

steps.whatToRemember: שמואל holds יש זיקה. The bond is real even with two יבמים, and it does not end by itself, even when the widow dies. Each of his two rulings teaches one of these points.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets the full reach of שמואל's view: the bond is strong in both number (two יבמים) and time (after death).

phrases.english: And if he had only taught us
that the halacha follows Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira,
I would have said: that applies [only] while she is alive,

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל לְאַחַר מִיתָה — פָּקְעָה לַהּ זִיקָה,
phrases.english: but after death the bond ends,
so he teaches us
that the bond does not end by itself.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִי אַשְׁמְעִינַן הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָה
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Both of שמואל's rulings are needed: one shows the bond is real even with two יבמים, the other shows it lasts even after the widow's death.

steps.title: New משנה: a brother born after the יבום
steps.stepSummary: After the second brother did יבום, a third brother is born and the second brother dies. Both of the second brother's wives are exempt.
steps.simpleTranslation: Two brothers. One dies, and the second marries the widow through יבום. Then a new brother is born, and the second brother dies. The first woman is exempt because she is the wife of a brother who never lived in the new brother's lifetime. The second woman is exempt because she is her צרה (co-wife).
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה opens with a case and its ruling. Pay attention to the order of events: the יבום happened first, and only afterward was the new brother born.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first woman was originally the wife of the first brother, who died before the new brother was born. So for the new brother she is אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו and is forbidden to him. The second woman becomes exempt as well, because she is a co-wife of a forbidden woman.

keyTerms.meaning: The wife of a brother who died before this brother was born. She is forbidden, and there is no יבום with her.
Her co-wife: another wife of the same husband.
He did יבום (married his dead brother's widow).

steps.confusionAlert: Both women were married to the SECOND brother when he died. 'The first' is the first brother's widow, whom he married through יבום. 'The second' is the wife he already had before that.

phrases.english: MISHNA: Two brothers,
and one of them died,
and the second did יבום with his brother's wife,
phrases.notes: The second brother already had a wife of his own, so now he has two wives.

phrases.aramaic: וְאַחַר כָּךְ נוֹלַד לָהֶן אָח, וּמֵת,
phrases.english: and afterward a brother was born to them, and he died,
phrases.notes: The one who 'died' here is the second brother, not the newborn.

phrases.english: the first woman goes free because she is his brother's wife
who was not in his world,
phrases.notes: Meaning the first brother died before the new brother was born.

phrases.english: and the second woman goes free because of her co-wife.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁנֵי אַחִים, וּמֵת אֶחָד מֵהֶן
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When the new brother was born after the יבום, both of the second brother's wives are exempt: one as אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, the other as her צרה.

steps.title: If the second brother only did מאמר
steps.stepSummary: If the second brother only did מאמר with the widow and then died, the second woman does חליצה but cannot do יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he only did מאמר with her and then died, the second woman does חליצה and does not do יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה adds a variation on the same case. This time the second brother did only מאמר with the widow (a first-stage betrothal for יבום), not a full יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A מאמר is not a full marriage, so the second woman is not fully a צרה, and she is not completely exempt. But the מאמר still creates some connection, so the second woman cannot do יבום and needs חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: A betrothal done for יבום by the Rabbis' rule. It comes before the full marriage.
She does חליצה (the ceremony that releases her from יבום).

phrases.english: If he did מאמר with her and died,
the second woman does חליצה and does not do יבום.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: With only a מאמר, the second woman needs חליצה and may not do יבום.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: he may choose either woman
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון says the new brother may do יבום or חליצה with whichever woman he wants.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: he does יבום with whichever of them he wants, or does חליצה with whichever of them he wants.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי שמעון argues with the first case of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי שמעון, the new brother was born when the woman was already married to his living second brother. So he does not treat her as אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. That means neither woman is forbidden to him, and normal יבום applies.

keyTerms.meaning: With whichever one of them he wants.

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says:
He does יבום with whichever of them he wants,
or does חליצה with whichever of them he wants.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: If the brother was born after the יבום, the wife is not אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, and the new brother may choose either woman for יבום or חליצה.
steps.whatToRemember: The חכמים say both women are exempt. רבי שמעון says regular יבום applies, because the יבום happened before the new brother was born.

steps.title: רב אושעיא: רבי שמעון argues in the first משנה too
steps.stepSummary: רב אושעיא says רבי שמעון also disagrees in the פרק's first משנה, where the brother was born before the יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אושעיא said: רבי שמעון disagreed even in the first case.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens with a claim from רב אושעיא. It stretches רבי שמעון's argument to a case our משנה does not spell out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Our משנה only shows רבי שמעון arguing when the brother was born AFTER the יבום. רב אושעיא says רבי שמעון also allows יבום in the first משנה, where the brother was born BEFORE the יבום. That is a bigger claim.

keyTerms.meaning: In the first one. Here it means the first משנה of the פרק.

phrases.english: GEMARA: Rav Oshaya said:
Rabbi Shimon was disagreeing
even in the first one.
phrases.notes: This is the first משנה of the פרק, where the brother was born before the second brother did יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב אוֹשַׁעְיָא: חָלוּק הָיָה רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אַף בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי שמעון argues even when the brother was born before the יבום.

steps.title: How do we know?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what source רב אושעיא has for his claim.
steps.simpleTranslation: From where do we know this?
steps.whatsHappening: This short question sets up the next move. The גמרא wants the source for רב אושעיא's claim.
steps.deeperAnalysis: No משנה states openly that רבי שמעון argues in the first case. So the גמרא needs to know what this claim is built on.

keyTerms.meaning: From where? How do we know?

phrases.english: From where?

steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for the claim that רבי שמעון argues in the first משנה.

steps.title: Because a משנה would be extra
steps.stepSummary: The proof is that one משנה would be unnecessary if רבי שמעון agreed in that case.
steps.simpleTranslation: From the fact that it teaches an extra משנה.
steps.whatsHappening: The answer is short: there is a משנה that would be extra. The next lines explain exactly why.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה does not waste words. If a whole משנה seems unnecessary, it must be there to teach something. Here, it teaches that רבי שמעון disagrees.

keyTerms.meaning: An extra משנה, one that seems to teach nothing new.

phrases.english: From the fact that it teaches an extra משנה.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The proof comes from the extra משנה.

steps.title: Whose view is the first משנה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whose opinion the earlier משנה (born before the יבום) follows.
steps.simpleTranslation: The earlier section: according to whom is it taught?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts working out the proof. It asks which view the first משנה was written for, so it can test each option.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are two possibilities: the חכמים or רבי שמעון. The next step checks the חכמים first.

keyTerms.meaning: The earlier section. Here it means the previous משנה.

phrases.english: The section of the earlier part,
for whom does it teach it?

steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whose view the first משנה was taught for.

steps.title: It can't be just for the חכמים
steps.stepSummary: For the חכמים, the first משנה would be obvious. They forbid even the harder case of our משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If you say it is for the חכמים: they forbid her even when the יבום came first and the brother was born later, when she was permitted at the time he found her. Then do we need to be told the case where he was born first and the יבום came later?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא tests the option that the first משנה follows the חכמים, and rejects it with a קל וחומר-style argument.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Our משנה is the 'harder' case to forbid: when the new brother was born, the woman was married to a living brother and was not a forbidden widow. If the חכמים forbid her even here, then of course they forbid her when he was born first. So the first משנה would teach nothing new for them.

keyTerms.meaning: Now, if even (the opening of an 'all the more so' argument).

phrases.english: If you say for the Rabbis,
now, when he did יבום and only later the brother was born,
where when he found her,
phrases.notes: 'Found her' means at the moment the new brother was born.

phrases.english: he found her in a permitted state,
phrases.notes: She was then the wife of a living brother, not a dead brother's widow.

phrases.english: the Rabbis forbid,
if he was born and only afterward the יבום happened, is it necessary to say?

steps.triggerLanguage: אִילֵּימָא לְרַבָּנַן, הַשְׁתָּא יִבֵּם וּלְבַסּוֹף נוֹלַד
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The option that the first משנה was taught for the חכמים.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: For the חכמים it would be extra, since our משנה already forbids the less obvious case.

steps.title: So it must be needed for רבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: The first משנה must be there because of רבי שמעון, so he must argue in that case too.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, isn't it needed for רבי שמעון?
steps.whatsHappening: Once the חכמים option is out, the גמרא points to רבי שמעון as the reason the first משנה was taught. The explanation of why continues after this line.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the first משנה is needed only because of רבי שמעון, then he must have a different view in that case. This supports רב אושעיא's claim.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows how the גמרא learns a hidden argument just from the fact that the משנה does not repeat itself.

phrases.english: Rather, is it not that
it was needed for Rabbi Shimon,

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The first משנה was taught because of רבי שמעון, which shows he argues in that case too.

steps.title: Each משנה shows how far one side goes
steps.stepSummary: The earlier משנה shows the full reach of רבי שמעון's leniency. The later משנה shows the full reach of the חכמים's strictness. רבי שמעון's disagreement is only written at the end so the חכמים could finish first.
steps.simpleTranslation: The first משנה was taught to show how far רבי שמעון goes, and the later one to show how far the חכמים go. Really רבי שמעון should have been quoted arguing in the first משנה, but the author waited until the חכמים finished their words, and then wrote that he argues with them.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why both משניות are needed, and why רבי שמעון's name only appears in the later one even though he argues in both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 18 proved that רבי שמעון argues even when the brother was born before the יבום. That raises a problem: why is he not quoted there? The answer is that the author let the חכמים finish all their cases first, and then wrote רבי שמעון's single disagreement, which covers both.

keyTerms.meaning: The first part. Here, the earlier משנה about a brother born before the יבום
The later part. Here, our משנה about a brother born after the יבום
His strength: how far his opinion reaches

steps.whatToRemember: Both משניות are needed. The first shows how lenient רבי שמעון is (born before יבום, still permitted). The second shows how strict the חכמים are (born after יבום, still forbidden).

phrases.english: And the first one was taught
to let you know the strength of רבי שמעון's view,
phrases.notes: "Strength" here means how far his leniency goes: he permits her even when the brother was born before the יבום.

phrases.english: and the later one was taught
to let you know the strength of the Rabbis' view.

phrases.aramaic: וּבְדִין הוּא דְּנִפְלוֹג רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בְּרֵישָׁא,
phrases.english: And by right רבי שמעון should have disagreed in the first one,
but he waited for the Rabbis
until they finished their words,
and then he disagreed with them.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּתְנָא רֵישָׁא לְהוֹדִיעֲךָ כֹּחוֹ דְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the proof of step 18 by explaining how the two משניות fit together.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explaining how the משנה is organized
steps.terutzHavaAmina: If רבי שמעון argues in the first משנה, his name should appear there.
steps.terutzMaskana: The author held back רבי שמעון's disagreement until the חכמים finished, so his one statement covers both cases.

steps.title: When does the prohibition apply for רבי שמעון?
steps.stepSummary: If רבי שמעון permits her in both cases, when does the prohibition of אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו ever apply for him?
steps.simpleTranslation: But according to רבי שמעון, how can you ever find a case of the wife of a brother who was not alive at the same time as him?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks in which case רבי שמעון would still forbid the wife of a brother who never lived at the same time as the new brother.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון permits her whether the brother was born before or after the יבום. That makes it look as if the prohibition of אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו almost never applies for him. The גמרא wants a case where it still does.

keyTerms.meaning: The wife of a brother who was never alive at the same time as him. She is forbidden, and there is no יבום with her
How can you find it? Meaning, in what case does this apply?

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
phrases.english: But the wife of his brother who was not in his world,
phrases.notes: "Not in his world" means the two brothers were never alive at the same time.

phrases.english: according to רבי שמעון, how can you find it?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Since רבי שמעון is now shown to permit in both cases, the גמרא asks where his prohibition still applies.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: A case where, even for רבי שמעון, the prohibition of אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו still applies.

steps.title: Two cases where רבי שמעון still forbids
steps.stepSummary: One case: there was only one brother, he died, and then a new brother was born. Another case: there were two brothers, and the living one never did יבום and did not die.
steps.simpleTranslation: It can be found with a single brother who died, and afterward a brother was born to him. Or, with two brothers, where the living one did not do יבום and did not die.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives two cases where רבי שמעון agrees the widow is forbidden to the brother born later.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the first case there was no other brother at all, so the widow is simply the wife of a brother the baby never lived alongside. In the second case no יבום happened and the living brother did not die. Her bond toward the new brother still comes from the dead brother, whom the baby never lived alongside.

keyTerms.meaning: Or alternatively: introduces a second possible answer
He did יבום (married his dead brother's widow)

phrases.english: With one brother, who died,
and a brother was born to him.
phrases.notes: The new brother was born after the only brother had already died.

phrases.english: Or alternatively: with two,
and he did not do יבום, and did not die.

steps.triggerLanguage: בְּחַד אַחָא, וּמִית, וְנוֹלַד לוֹ אָח
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Either there was only one brother, who died before the new one was born, or the second brother never did יבום and is still alive.

steps.title: Why permit her when the brother was born before the יבום?
steps.stepSummary: If the יבום came first, the new brother finds her already permitted. But if he was born before the יבום, why does רבי שמעון permit her?
steps.simpleTranslation: It makes sense when the brother did יבום and only afterward the new brother was born: when he was born, she was already permitted. But if he was born and only afterward the brother did יבום, what is רבי שמעון's reason?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא accepts רבי שמעון's leniency in the later case, and asks for his reason in the earlier case, where the baby was born before the יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When the יבום came first, at the moment of birth she was the wife of a living brother, so there is a simple reason to permit her. When the baby was born first, at birth she was still the widow of a brother he never lived alongside. So why should she be allowed?

keyTerms.meaning: It makes sense: introduces a case that is understood, before asking about a harder one

phrases.english: It makes sense when he did יבום and afterward the brother was born:
when he found her,
phrases.notes: "Found her" means at the moment the new brother was born.

phrases.english: he found her in a permitted state.
But if he was born and afterward the brother did יבום,
what is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to רבי שמעון's leniency, now proven to cover the first משנה, and asks for his reasoning there.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רבי שמעון permits her when the new brother was born before the יבום.

steps.title: רבי שמעון holds that זיקה makes her like a married woman
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון holds יש זיקה. A widow tied to the living brother by זיקה already counts as married to him.
steps.simpleTranslation: He holds that there is a זיקה, and a woman with a זיקה is like a married woman.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that for רבי שמעון, the bond of זיקה already makes her like the living brother's wife, even before the יבום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because of the זיקה, when the baby was born she already counted as the wife of a brother who was alive together with him. So she is not אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו toward him, even though the actual יבום came later.

keyTerms.meaning: The bond between a widow and her dead husband's brothers, before יבום or חליצה
She is like a married woman

phrases.english: He holds: there is a זיקה,
and a woman with a זיקה is like a married woman.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: רבי שמעון holds יש זיקה, and זיקה makes her like the living brother's wife, so the new brother counts her as the wife of a brother who lived alongside him.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up the idea that רבי שמעון's leniency rests on זיקה. רב יוסף attacks exactly this point in the next step.

steps.title: רב יוסף: רבי שמעון is unsure even about זיקה plus מאמר
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון is unsure whether זיקה together with מאמר makes her like a married woman. So how could זיקה alone make her one?
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יוסף objected: Now, רבי שמעון is unsure whether a woman with a זיקה and a מאמר is like a married woman or not. Is there even a question about זיקה alone?
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף challenges the answer of step 23, saying it cannot be רבי שמעון's reason.
steps.deeperAnalysis: זיקה together with מאמר is a stronger tie than זיקה alone. If רבי שמעון is unsure even about the stronger tie, he surely would not say the weaker tie alone makes her a married woman. So the reason given in step 23 looks wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: A kind of קידושין that the יבם gives the widow before the full יבום

steps.confusionAlert: רב יוסף is not saying רבי שמעון holds זיקה means nothing. He is saying that a doubt about the stronger case (זיקה plus מאמר) makes a definite rule about the weaker case (זיקה alone) impossible.

phrases.english: Rav Yosef objected to it:
Now, with זיקה together with מאמר,
רבי שמעון is unsure
whether she is like a married woman
or not like a married woman;
is it even a question about זיקה alone?
phrases.notes: He means: surely זיקה alone, the weaker tie, does not make her a married woman.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the reason given in step 23.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that רבי שמעון holds זיקה alone makes her like a married woman.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: This is a קל וחומר: if רבי שמעון is unsure about the stronger case of זיקה plus מאמר, he cannot be certain that זיקה alone makes her married.

steps.title: Where is this doubt of רבי שמעון found?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of the claim that רבי שמעון is unsure about זיקה plus מאמר.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the source for this?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks where we see that רבי שמעון is unsure about זיקה plus מאמר. This is a setup line, and the answer comes in the next steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 24's challenge relied on a claim about רבי שמעון's opinion. Before that claim can carry weight, the גמרא has to show where it comes from.

keyTerms.meaning: What is it? Here it means: what is the source?

phrases.english: What is it?
phrases.notes: He's asking where we see רבי שמעון's doubt from step 24.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the claim used in step 24's challenge.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source showing that רבי שמעון is unsure whether זיקה plus מאמר makes a woman count as married.

steps.title: The three brothers case: both widows do only חליצה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a משנה. Three brothers are married to three unrelated women. The first brother dies, the second does מאמר with his widow and then dies too. Both of the second brother's widows must do חליצה and may not do יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned in a משנה: three brothers were married to three unrelated women. One of the brothers died. The second brother did מאמר with the widow, and then he died too. These women must do חליצה and may not do יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins quoting the משנה that will prove רבי שמעון's doubt. This first part gives the case and the ruling of the רבנן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The second brother left two women behind: his own wife, and his brother's widow whom he did מאמר with. The משנה rules that the third brother may not do יבום with either one, only חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: As we learned in a משנה
Unrelated women, with no family tie that would forbid them
A betrothal made by the יבם with the widow before יבום (a rabbinic step)
They do חליצה, the release ceremony

steps.confusionAlert: נׇכְרִיּוֹת here does not mean non-Jewish women. It just means women who are not related to each other, so no relative-based prohibition is involved.

phrases.english: As we learned: three brothers
married to three unrelated women,
and one of them died,
and the second did מאמר with her, and died —
phrases.notes: So now the second brother leaves two women: his own wife and the widow he did מאמר with.

phrases.english: these women do חליצה and do not do יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּתְנַן: שְׁלֹשָׁה אַחִין נְשׂוּאִין שָׁלֹשׁ נָשִׁים נׇכְרִיּוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins answering step 25's question by quoting the source.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי שמעון is unsure whether זיקה plus מאמר makes her count as married
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה about three brothers and מאמר

steps.title: The reason from the פסוק: only a woman tied to one יבם
steps.stepSummary: The reason for the רבנן's ruling comes from the פסוק. יבום is only for a woman tied to one יבם, not a woman tied to two.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it says: "And one of them dies... her יבם shall come to her." This means a woman tied by זיקה to one יבם, and not a woman tied by זיקה to two יבמין.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the reason the first brother's widow cannot have יבום. She is tied to two brothers, and the פסוק only allows יבום for a woman tied to one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first brother's widow became tied to the second brother when the first brother died. Then the מאמר and the second brother's death tied her again to the third brother. The רבנן learn from "עָלֶיהָ" that a double tie blocks יבום.

keyTerms.meaning: A levirate tie to a single יבם
יבמים, the brothers-in-law who could do יבום

phrases.aramaic: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וּמֵת אֶחָד מֵהֶם ... יְבָמָהּ יָבֹא עָלֶיהָ״,
phrases.english: As it says: "And one of them dies... her יבם shall come to her,"
phrases.notes: דברים 25:5

phrases.english: one who has on her the tie of one יבם,
phrases.notes: The lesson comes from the word עָלֶיהָ, "on her": she has a tie to only one brother on her.

phrases.english: and not one who has on her the tie of two יבמין.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the פסוק behind step 26's ruling.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A woman tied by זיקה to two יבמין cannot have יבום, only חליצה.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: יבום with one, חליצה with the other
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון argues. The third brother may do יבום with whichever woman he chooses, and must do חליצה with the other one.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: he does יבום with whichever one of them he wants, and does חליצה with the second.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי שמעון disagrees with the רבנן. He allows יבום with one of the two women, but the other must do חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון does not accept the rule from the פסוק that a double tie blocks יבום. Still, he does not let the third brother marry both women. That limit is what reveals his doubt, as the next step explains.

phrases.english: רבי שמעון says:
he does יבום with whichever of them he wants,
and does חליצה with the second.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: מְיַיבֵּם לְאֵיזֶהוּ מֵהֶן שֶׁיִּרְצֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רבי שמעון's opposing view in the same משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: יבום with one woman of his choice, and חליצה with the other.

steps.title: Why not יבום with both? Maybe the זיקה is real
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains why רבי שמעון forbids יבום with both women. Maybe זיקה is real, so the מאמר widow might count as the second brother's wife. Then both women would count as two widows coming from one house.
steps.simpleTranslation: But יבום with both, no. Because maybe there is זיקה, and they would be two יבמות that come...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains why רבי שמעון does not allow the third brother to marry both women. This is the proof that רבי שמעון is unsure about זיקה plus מאמר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If זיקה plus מאמר surely did not make her married, רבי שמעון would allow יבום with both women. He forbids it only because "perhaps" (דְּדִלְמָא) יש זיקה, which shows he is unsure, not certain. That uncertainty is exactly the support step 24's challenge needed.

keyTerms.meaning: To do יבום with both of them
There is a real levirate tie, enough to count her as his wife

steps.whyThisMatters: This proves the point behind step 24's question. If רבי שמעון is unsure even about זיקה plus מאמר, he cannot hold that זיקה alone surely makes a woman married.

phrases.english: to do יבום with both of them, no —
phrases.notes: This is the גמרא speaking now, explaining the משנה, not the משנה itself.

phrases.english: because perhaps there is זיקה,
and they would be two יבמות that come

steps.triggerLanguage: יַבּוֹמֵי תַּרְוַיְיהוּ לָא — דְּדִלְמָא יֵשׁ זִיקָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains רבי שמעון's limit in step 28, which shows his doubt.
steps.raayaObject: רבי שמעון is unsure whether זיקה plus מאמר makes her a married woman
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי שמעון's ruling in the משנה: יבום with one woman only, חליצה with the other
